lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh the lock file of the functions weekly, so indirect dependencies (like fast-uri or fast-xml-parser) come in one PR instead of one PR each

packageRules.description: Label npm updates like Dependabot did
Label GitHub Actions updates like Dependabot did
GitHub Actions and the devcontainer: weekly with a 7 day cooldown, like Dependabot did
All non-major npm updates of the functions in one PR
Docker Hub returns no release timestamps for the node image, so the minimum release age would keep it pending forever
Leave runner labels and action version inputs alone, Dependabot never updated those

Our own actions that follow a branch (like home-assistant/actions@master) float on purpose. Pinning them would open a digest PR in every repository for each change to them. Our own actions on a version tag are pinned like any other.
